title: Vast_Unexplored
description: A lightweight fabric integration package, serving as the client for Vast_Unexplored server (of course, it can also be downloaded separately as an original optimization package)
body:
A lightweight fabric integration package, serving as the client for Vast_Unexplored server (of course, it can also be downloaded separately as an original optimization package)
This integration package has been optimized for performance and UI beautification of the original version, and has a built-in access address for Vast_Unexplored.
